facts.fact: The document is the text of Angola's Lei n.º 3/11 of 14 January 2011, the Lei do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, passed by the Assembleia Nacional and published in the Diário da República I Série n.º 9 on that date; it replaces the 1996 statistics law (Lei n.º 15/96) and sets up the national statistical system.

facts.fact: Angop reports that INE opened a public consultation on 29 September 2026, to 2 October, on a proposed revision of the Lei do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, with the draft documents posted on the INE portal.

facts.fact: INE cites the accessibility principle of Lei n.º 3/11 of 14 January, Lei do Sistema Estatístico Nacional, as the basis for publishing the 2024 census results and 10% of microdata, treating it as the current law (release dated 20 November 2025).

facts.fact: Decreto Presidencial n.º 43/26 of 10 March 2026 is the organic statute of INE, setting it up as central executive body of the national statistical system under the Lei do Sistema de Estatística Nacional and revoking the 2017 statute.
